rows.behavior: Subagent ids named together anywhere in the stream are grouped before classification; each group's updates fold in original stream order and the subagent is listed once

claims.claim: A subagent may be named by conversation_id or log_uri
Once any update names both ids, every update under either id belongs to one subagent, wherever the linking update falls
Updates are folded in stream order through the same classifier, and the subagent is listed once
A failed state and an error message sent in separate updates count together; a refusal is not cleared later
The tool-step matcher uses state and error wording; an ERROR whose message contains a matched word such as approval counts as a refusal.
